v3.revise.help.en: The approved version stays archived. Your edits continue in a new version.
v3.revise.help.zh: 已批准版本会保留存档，新的修改将在新版本中继续。

pw.alts.none.en: No more alternatives for this line.

pw.ep.sub.en: Original on top, adaptation below; every change explains itself.
pw.ep.sub.zh: 原文在上，改编在下；每一处改动都写明了理由。

pw.export.hint.en: Export the finalized files any time

pw.final.banner.en: This episode is finalized and archived

pw.finalize.confirm.en: Finalizing freezes this episode with a hash; further edits need a new revision.
pw.finalize.confirm.zh: 定稿后本集将冻结存档，再改需另起修订稿。

pw.gen.body.en: The AI rewrites each line in natural American English — not a translation, but a rewrite of rhythm and tone for U.S. viewers. Every change carries a Chinese explanation, and you can edit any line afterwards.
pw.gen.body.zh: AI 将逐句改写为地道的美式表达——不是翻译，而是为美国观众重写台词的节奏与语气。每一处改动都附中文说明，生成后您可以逐句修改。

pw.gen.step3.en: Adapting each line for U.S. viewers

pw.gen.unmatched.en: {n} line(s) have no pre-authored translation (demo mode covers the bundled scripts only).
pw.gen.unmatched.zh: 有 {n} 句暂无预置译文（演示模式仅覆盖内置剧本）。

pw.home.sub.en: Localize subtitles, refine the English adaptation, and deliver timed files.
pw.home.sub.zh: 上传字幕，生成自然的英文改编，校准时间轴并交付。

pw.line.pending.en: This line has not been adapted yet.

pw.new.notesHint.en: Main characters' names, roles and relationships; the adaptation uses this.
pw.new.notesHint.zh: 主要角色的姓名、身份与关系，改编时会参考。

pw.new.sub.en: Fill in the title's info and upload each episode's script or subtitle file.
pw.new.sub.zh: 填写剧集信息并上传每集的剧本或字幕文件。

pw.title.noEpisodes.en: No episodes yet — upload a script first.
pw.title.noEpisodes.zh: 还没有单集，请先上传剧本。

pw.upload.hint.en: SRT / VTT / ASS subtitle files or a TXT script; one file per episode.
pw.upload.hint.zh: 支持 SRT / VTT / ASS 字幕文件或 TXT 剧本；一集一个文件。

pw.review.banner.zh: Pulsar 已提交这一版。您可以直接定稿，或自己修改后再定稿。
pw.review.banner.en: Pulsar submitted this version. Finalize it as is, or edit it yourself first.

pw.alts.suggested.zh: 备选说法——点击即可替换
pw.alts.suggested.en: Suggested alternatives — tap to use one

pw.cmd.confirm.body.zh: 点击任意时间码审阅译文——需要就直接改，或换一个说法；每场确认后即可定稿。
pw.cmd.confirm.body.en: Click any timestamp to review a line — edit it directly or take an alternative; confirm each scene, then finalize.

pw.cmd.ready.body.zh: 所有场景已确认。定稿后本集冻结存档，可随时导出。
pw.cmd.ready.body.en: Every scene is confirmed. Finalizing freezes and archives this episode; export any time.

pw.cmd.review.body.zh: 您可以直接定稿，或自己修改后再定稿。
pw.cmd.review.body.en: Finalize it as is, or edit it yourself first.

pw.cmd.done.body.zh: 内容已冻结存档，右侧可导出定稿文件。
pw.cmd.done.body.en: Content is frozen and archived; export the finalized files on the right.

pw.confirm.done.zh: 已更新，左侧剧本已同步。
pw.confirm.done.en: Updated — the script on the left reflects it.

pw.confirm.hint.zh: 修改或选中备选后，点击“确认修改”生效。
pw.confirm.hint.en: Edit the line or pick an alternative, then confirm to apply.

pw.confirm.clean.zh: 可直接修改上方英文，或查看备选说法。
pw.confirm.clean.en: Edit the English above, or view the alternatives.

pw.cmd2.lines.body.zh: 点击任意时间码：直接改英文，或换一个说法。全部就绪后即可定稿。
pw.cmd2.lines.body.en: Click any timestamp — edit the English directly or take an alternative. Finalize once every line is ready.

pw.cmd2.ready.body.zh: 全部台词已改编。定稿后即可导出英文剧本与带字幕视频。
pw.cmd2.ready.body.en: Every line is adapted. Finalize to export the English script and the subtitled video.

pw.cmd2.done.body.zh: 内容已冻结存档。右侧可下载英文剧本与带字幕视频。
pw.cmd2.done.body.en: Frozen and archived. Download the English script and the subtitled video from the rail.

pw.finalize.blocked2.zh: 请先完成所有台词的改编

pw.subvid.done.zh: 已生成带字幕视频（{n} 句），已在新窗口打开。
pw.subvid.done.en: Subtitled video ready ({n} cues) — opened in a new tab.

pw.upload.hint2.zh: 一集一行：填集数，选这一集的字幕/剧本文件，视频可选。
pw.upload.hint2.en: One row per episode: set the number, pick that episode's subtitle/script file; video optional.

qc.pass.zh: 全部通过（{n} 句已检查）

qc.reading_speed.zh: 阅读速度 {value} 字符/秒（上限 {limit}）

qc.overlap.zh: 与上一句重叠 {value} 毫秒

qc.tiny_gap.zh: 与上一句间隔仅 {value} 毫秒

pw.upload.hint3.zh: 每集可先上传视频、字幕/剧本，或两者一起上传。推广可直接使用视频；改编可稍后补字幕。文件会按名称自动归到对应集数。
pw.upload.hint3.en: Upload video, subtitles/script, or both for each episode. Promote can start from video; Adapt can add text later. Files sort into episodes by filename.

pw.upload.pick.zh: 把所有文件拖到这里，或点击选择
pw.upload.pick.en: Drop all your files here, or click to choose

pw.upload.pickHint.zh: 字幕和视频一起拖：按文件名自动归到对应剧集（第1集.srt、第1集.mp4 …）
pw.upload.pickHint.en: Subtitles and videos together — matched to episodes by filename (ep1.srt, ep1.mp4 …)

pw.slots.sub.zh: 字幕 / 剧本（可稍后补）

pw.slots.missingSub.en: This episode still needs its subtitle file

pw.gen.nomatch.zh: 这部剧本不在演示语料中，演示模式无法自动改编。请联系 Pulsar 为您的工作区开启 AI 改编。
pw.gen.nomatch.en: This script isn't in the demo bank, so demo mode can't adapt it. Ask Pulsar to enable AI adaptation for your workspace.

pw.gen.overrun.en: taking longer than estimated — still generating…

st.notFinal.title.zh: 先定稿剧本，再制作字幕
st.notFinal.title.en: Finalize the script first, then style the subtitles

st.notFinal.body.zh: 字幕基于定稿后的英文剧本制作，这样改动不会再影响成片。回到剧集工作台完成审阅并定稿，这里就会解锁。
st.notFinal.body.en: Subtitles are built from the frozen, finalized script so later edits can't drift into the delivered video. Finish reviewing and finalize in the episode studio, and this page unlocks.

st.untimed.body.zh: 字幕需要每句台词的起止时间。这一集是纯文本剧本（或没有可用台词），无法生成字幕；上传 SRT/VTT/ASS 字幕文件的剧集才支持。英文剧本报告仍可下载。
st.untimed.body.en: Subtitles need a start and end time for every line. This episode came from a plain-text script (or has no usable lines), so cues can't be generated — episodes ingested from SRT/VTT/ASS files support subtitles. The English script report is still available.

st.noVideo.zh: 未上传视频 — 预览以样式示意
st.noVideo.en: No video attached — previewing style only

st.render.note.zh: 一分钟 720p 视频约需 20–40 秒。

st.render.download.zh: 下载带字幕视频（{n} 条字幕）

st.render.noVideo.zh: 这一集还没有视频：回剧集工作台上传后，即可在此渲染带字幕成片。SRT/VTT 文件不受影响，可直接下载。
st.render.noVideo.en: No video on this episode yet — attach one in the episode studio to render the burned video here. The SRT/VTT files below work regardless.

st.retime.body.zh: 检测到每句台词开头带有 [时:分:秒] 时间戳 —— 这是修复前的导入把时间码留在了文本里。一键修复即可提取时间轴（结束时间取自下一句），若该集已定稿会自动重新定稿。
st.retime.body.en: Each line here starts with an [hh:mm:ss] stamp — an earlier ingest left the timecodes inside the text. One click lifts them into a real timeline (end times from the following line) and, if this episode was finalized, refinalizes it automatically.

st.retime.review.zh: 时间轴已修复，但质检发现需要处理的问题：请回剧集工作台检查后重新定稿。
st.retime.review.en: Timeline repaired, but QC found issues to address — review in the episode studio, then finalize again.

qc.fix.done.zh: 已修复 {n} 处；剩余 {m} 处必须修复。

st.t.offsetHint.zh: 负值让所有字幕提前（画面说话早于字幕时用负值）。应用后立即生效，且只应用一次。
st.t.offsetHint.en: Negative shifts every subtitle earlier (use negative when the audio runs ahead of the subs). Applied once, immediately.

st.t.pickCue.zh: 先在下方字幕表里点一句台词，再回到这里调整它的出现和消失时间。
st.t.pickCue.en: Click a line in the cue sheet below first - then adjust when it appears and disappears here.

st.t.keys.zh: 快捷键：, 和 . 移动选中句 ∓100ms；按住 Shift 为 500ms。
st.t.keys.en: Keys: , and . nudge the selected cue by 100 ms; hold Shift for 500 ms.

st.t.warn.overlap.zh: 第 {n} 句与上一句重叠 {v} 毫秒
st.t.warn.overlap.en: Cue {n} overlaps the previous by {v} ms

st.t.warn.reversed.zh: 第 {n} 句结束早于开始

st.t.warn.beyond_video.zh: 第 {n} 句超出视频 {v} 毫秒
st.t.warn.beyond_video.en: Cue {n} runs {v} ms past the video

st.t.applyProposals.zh: 把接受的调整加入待保存

v3.subtitle.timingHint.zh: 调整字幕出现时间并解决时间轴问题
v3.subtitle.timingHint.en: Adjust cue timing and resolve timeline issues

v3.subtitle.deliveryHint.zh: 预览字幕样式并导出最终文件
v3.subtitle.deliveryHint.en: Preview subtitle styling and export final files

v3.title.actionHint.zh: 每集只显示下一项操作
v3.title.actionHint.en: Each episode shows its next action

v3.title.addEpisodesHint.zh: 上传新的字幕或视频文件
v3.title.addEpisodesHint.en: Upload new subtitle or video files

v3.done.body.zh: 台词已定稿。需要更改可创建新修订稿；要继续，请打开上方的对轴与交付。
v3.done.body.en: The script is finalized. Create a new draft to revise it, or continue in Timing & delivery above.

qc.fix.allclear.zh: 已修复 {n} 处，预检全部通过。

pw.alts.picked.zh: 已填入所选备选，点击下方保存按钮确认。
pw.alts.picked.en: Alternative applied - press the save button below to confirm.

qc.fix.none.zh: AI 修复 — 目前没有可修复项
qc.fix.none.en: Fix with AI - nothing to fix right now

st.acc.timing.sub.zh: 字幕早了或晚了？在这里对齐
st.acc.timing.sub.en: Subtitles early or late? Line them up here

st.acc.deliver.sub.zh: 带字幕视频与字幕文件
st.acc.deliver.sub.en: The subtitled video and the files

st.suggest.body.zh: 字幕看起来整体偏晚：时间戳按整秒取整（抽帧提取的典型痕迹）。建议整体提前 0.5 秒。
st.suggest.body.en: The subtitles look uniformly late: the timestamps are rounded to whole seconds (a frame-sampling artifact). Recommended: shift everything 0.5s earlier.

st.t.cue.tip.zh: 在下方字幕表点一句台词后，可在这里精确调整它出现和消失的时间。
st.t.cue.tip.en: Click a line in the cue sheet below, then adjust exactly when it appears and disappears here.

st.t.setStart.tip.zh: 把这一句的出现时间改为播放器当前时刻
st.t.setStart.tip.en: Make this line appear at the player's current moment

st.t.setEnd.tip.zh: 把这一句的消失时间改为播放器当前时刻
st.t.setEnd.tip.en: Make this line disappear at the player's current moment

st.t.offset.tip.zh: 所有字幕一起提前或推后
st.t.offset.tip.en: Shift every subtitle earlier or later together

st.t.loop.tip.zh: 反复播放选中的这一句
st.t.loop.tip.en: Replay the selected line on repeat

st.t.before.tip.zh: 从选中句前 2 秒开始播放，听清入点
st.t.before.tip.en: Play from 2s before the selected line to hear the entry

st.merge.hint.zh: 相邻的两条短字幕合成上下两行同时显示，停留更久、闪烁更少。仅限纯英文内容。
st.merge.hint.en: Two short neighboring cues display together as two rows - on screen longer, less flicker. English-only content.

pw.alts.dir.title.zh: 都不合适？换个方向再写一版
pw.alts.dir.title.en: Neither one? Take it another direction

pw.cmd.blocked.body.zh: 交付预检发现问题。用右侧的「修复」或「AI 修复全部」处理，完成后即可定稿。
pw.cmd.blocked.body.en: Preflight found blocking issues. Use Fix or Fix all with AI in the panel, then finalize.

qc.fix.timingDone.zh: 已修正 {n} 处时间重叠。
